data.name: Setting_CleanupOnSave_Description
data.value: Clean each document right before it is saved.

data.name: Setting_RemoveUnusedLocalVariables_Description
data.value: Removes locals reported as CS0168 / CS0219. Skipped when the file has compile errors.

data.name: Setting_RemoveUnusedUsings_Description
data.value: Removes using directives reported as CS8019. Skipped when the file has compile errors.

data.name: Setting_SortUsings_Description
data.value: global → normal → static → alias; System.* first; then alphabetical.

data.name: Setting_RemoveConsecutiveBlankLines_Description
data.value: Keeps at most one blank line in a row. Never touches strings or disabled code.

data.name: Setting_IncludeCSharp_Description
data.value: Cleaned with Roslyn, in the background and in parallel.

data.name: Setting_EditorFormatted_Description
data.value: Formatted with the Visual Studio editor.

data.name: Setting_AdditionalFileExtensions_Description
data.value: Extensions not covered by the groups above, formatted with the Visual Studio editor. Separate with ';' (e.g. .skin;.sitemap).

data.name: Setting_IgnoreGeneratedCode_Description
data.value: Skips *.designer.cs, *.g.cs, files under obj\ and files marked <auto-generated>.

data.name: Setting_ExcludeT4GeneratedCode_Description
data.value: Skips files that have a .tt template with the same name.

data.name: Setting_ExcludePatterns_Description
data.value: Files whose full path matches any expression are skipped. Separate with ';'.

data.name: Setting_RegenerateWebFormsDesigner_Title
data.value: Regenerate Web Forms designer after formatting

data.name: Setting_RegenerateWebFormsDesigner_Description
data.value: After formatting .aspx/.ascx/.master files, regenerates their .designer.cs with 'Convert to Web Application' (Web Application projects only). Usually not needed: formatting does not change controls.
